cn_steps: 启用 `IoStore Prioritization`（模块 `IoStorePrioritization`），运行时插件。
在流式加载期间，用基于表达式的规则动态调整 IoStore I/O 请求的优先级。
为不同流送状态/玩法场景配置优先级表达式，让关键内容优先加载。
运行时模块可进游戏包；用于优化大世界的流送 I/O 调度。
en_steps: Enable `IoStore Prioritization` (module `IoStorePrioritization`), a runtime plugin.
During streaming, dynamically prioritize IoStore I/O requests using expression-based rules.
Author priority expressions per streaming state/gameplay scenario so critical content loads first.
Runtime modules can ship; it optimizes large-world streaming I/O scheduling.
note_cn: 基于表达式动态排序 IoStore I/O 优先级，优化流送。
note_en: Expression-based dynamic prioritization of IoStore I/O to optimize streaming.

cn_steps: 启用 `Iris IAD Bridge`（模块 `IrisIADBridge`）。
它实现 IrisCore 的异步加载扩展点，在 Iris 加载复制包之前安装按需内容（on-demand）。
把 IoStore/按需知识保留在 IrisCore 之外，由本桥接处理。
属 Iris 网络的按需内容扩展，需 Iris 启用。
en_steps: Enable `Iris IAD Bridge` (module `IrisIADBridge`).
It implements the IrisCore async-load extension point to install on-demand content before Iris loads a replicated package.
It keeps IoStore/on-demand knowledge out of IrisCore and handles it in the bridge.
It is an on-demand content extension for Iris networking; requires Iris enabled.
note_cn: Iris 按需内容加载桥接，把 on-demand 逻辑移出 IrisCore。
note_en: An Iris on-demand content bridge that keeps on-demand logic out of IrisCore.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Iris`（模块 `Iris`）。
在 `DefaultEngine.ini` 里显式打开 Iris 复制后端（替换或补充旧 Actor 复制）。
面向大规模 Actor 与更细的复制过滤；联机项目在服务器/客户端都要启用。
Experimental：接口可能随夜构建变化，先在联机测试环境验证复制行为。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Iris` (module `Iris`).
Explicitly turn on the Iris replication backend in `DefaultEngine.ini` (replacing or complementing classic Actor replication).
Aimed at large actor counts and finer replication filtering; enable it on both server and client in net projects.
Experimental: contract may change on nightlies; validate replication in a net test environment first.
note_cn: 新一代复制后端，需在 ini 显式开启，实验性。
note_en: The newer replication backend, explicitly enabled in ini, experimental.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `JOULE`（模块 `JOULECore`、`JOULEViz`，编辑器 `JOULEEditor`）。
联合优化 U(V) 晶格嵌入（Joint Optimized U(V) Lattice Embedding），用于几何/网格的晶格嵌入处理。
在编辑器里用 `JOULEEditor`/`JOULEViz` 调试与可视化嵌入结果。
Experimental：接口可能变动；`JOULEEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `JOULE` (modules `JOULECore`, `JOULEViz`, editor `JOULEEditor`).
It performs Joint Optimized U(V) Lattice Embedding for geometry/mesh lattice embedding.
Debug and visualize embedding results with `JOULEEditor`/`JOULEViz` in the editor.
Experimental: contract may change; `JOULEEditor` is Editor-target only.
note_cn: U(V) 晶格嵌入的联合优化工具，几何处理向，实验性。
note_en: A joint-optimized U(V) lattice embedding tool, geometry-oriented, experimental.

cn_steps: 启用 `Json Blueprint Utilities`（模块 `JsonBlueprintUtilities`、`JsonBlueprintGraph`）。
在蓝图里用其节点读写 JSON：解析字符串为 JSON 对象、取值、构造 JSON。
处理网络/配置文件返回的 JSON 数据，无需写 C++。
运行时模块可进游戏包；底层走 Json/JsonUtilities。
en_steps: Enable `Json Blueprint Utilities` (modules `JsonBlueprintUtilities`, `JsonBlueprintGraph`).
In Blueprint use its nodes to read/write JSON: parse strings into JSON objects, read fields, and build JSON.
Handle JSON from network/config files without C++.
Runtime modules can ship; it is backed by Json/JsonUtilities.
note_cn: 蓝图的 JSON 读写节点，底层走 JsonUtilities。
note_en: Blueprint JSON read/write nodes backed by JsonUtilities.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `JSON Web Token Plugin`（模块 `JWT`）。
用其 API 处理 JWT 数据：编码/解码、签名校验（登录鉴权、令牌交换等场景）。
在 C++ 里调用 JWT API，验证服务器下发的令牌。
Experimental：接口可能变动；注意密钥/令牌的安全存储。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `JSON Web Token Plugin` (module `JWT`).
Use its API to work with JWT data: encode/decode and verify signatures (login auth, token exchange, etc.).
Call the JWT API from C++ to validate tokens issued by your server.
Experimental: contract may change; store keys/tokens securely.
note_cn: 处理 JSON Web Token 的 API，用于鉴权，实验性。
note_en: An API for JSON Web Tokens used for auth, experimental.

cn_steps: 启用编辑器插件 `KDevelop Integration`（模块 `KDevelopSourceCodeAccess`）并重启。
在 `Project Settings > Source Code Access`（或首选源码编辑器）里选择 KDevelop。
从编辑器打开 C++ 文件时由 KDevelop 接管源码访问。
这是编辑器开发者工具，只进 Editor Target，不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable the editor plugin `KDevelop Integration` (module `KDevelopSourceCodeAccess`) and restart.
In `Project Settings > Source Code Access` (or preferred source editor), pick KDevelop.
Opening C++ files from the editor hands source access to KDevelop.
It is an editor developer tool for Editor targets only; it does not ship.
note_cn: 让编辑器用 KDevelop 打开源码，纯编辑器。
note_en: Lets the editor open source in KDevelop, editor-only.

cn_steps: 启用 `Kimodo`（模块 `Kimodo`），面向 `AnimGenOffline` 框架。
用 Kimodo 为 AnimGenOffline 离线动画生成流程提供插件能力（动作生成/处理）。
在离线管线里运行生成任务，产出动画资产再导入引擎。
这是动画生成管线插件；配合 AnimGenOffline 使用。
en_steps: Enable `Kimodo` (module `Kimodo`), part of the `AnimGenOffline` framework.
Use Kimodo to provide plugin capabilities to the AnimGenOffline offline motion-generation flow (motion generation/processing).
Run generation tasks in the offline pipeline and import the resulting animation assets.
It is an animation-generation pipeline plugin; used with AnimGenOffline.
note_cn: AnimGenOffline 框架下的 Kimodo 插件，离线动画生成。
note_en: The Kimodo plugin under AnimGenOffline, for offline motion generation.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Knowledge Base`（模块 `KnowledgeBase`）。
它提供知识库查询接口：知识库可来自实时引擎状态，或读取磁盘上的 markdown。
用于给编辑器/AI 提供可查询的项目知识（文档、引擎状态）。
Experimental：接口可能变动；属编辑器侧知识查询工具。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Knowledge Base` (module `KnowledgeBase`).
It provides a query interface over knowledge bases derived from live engine state or read from markdown on disk.
Use it to give the editor/AI queryable project knowledge (docs, engine state).
Experimental: contract may change; it is an editor-side knowledge query tool.
note_cn: 知识库查询接口（引擎状态/markdown），偏编辑器与 AI。
note_en: A knowledge-base query interface (engine state/markdown), editor and AI oriented.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `KnowledgeBaseToolset`（模块 `KnowledgeBaseToolset`），面向 AI Toolset Registry。
让 AI 助手通过 Toolset Registry 发现、搜索和编写知识库。
配合 `Knowledge Base` 使用，对项目知识做检索/录入。
这是开发期工具集，不是运行时功能；Experimental。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `KnowledgeBaseToolset` (module `KnowledgeBaseToolset`); it targets the AI Toolset Registry.
Let AI assistants discover, search, and write knowledge bases through the Toolset Registry.
Use it with `Knowledge Base` to retrieve or record project knowledge.
It is a development-time toolset, not a runtime feature; Experimental.
note_cn: 给 AI 工具链用的知识库工具集，配合 Knowledge Base。
note_en: A knowledge-base toolset for the AI toolchain, used with Knowledge Base.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Landmass`（运行时 `Landmass`，编辑器 `LandmassEditor`）。
用 Landmass 的 Brush/Actor 程序化塑造地形（雕刻、混合、程序化地貌）。
在关卡放置 Landmass 相关 Actor 编辑地形，与其他地形/景观系统配合。
Experimental：接口可能变动；`LandmassEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Landmass` (runtime `Landmass`, editor `LandmassEditor`).
Use Landmass brushes/actors to procedurally shape terrain (sculpting, blending, procedural landforms).
Place Landmass actors in the level to edit terrain, working with other terrain/landscape systems.
Experimental: contract may change; `LandmassEditor` is Editor-target only.
note_cn: 程序化地形塑造（Landmass/Mass 家族），与 Landscape 配合。
note_en: Procedural terrain shaping (Landmass/Mass family), used with Landscape.

cn_steps: 启用编辑器插件 `Landscape Patch`（模块 `LandscapePatch`、`LandscapePatchEditorOnly`）并重启。
把景观补丁组件附加到网格上，当网格移动/重新定位时影响景观。
用于让物件（如道路、水坑）随网格贴合并修改地形。
这是编辑器工具，服务制作流程，默认不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable the editor plugin `Landscape Patch` (modules `LandscapePatch`, `LandscapePatchEditorOnly`) and restart.
Attach landscape patch components to meshes so the landscape is affected as the mesh is repositioned.
Use it to make objects (roads, puddles, etc.) conform and modify terrain as they move.
It is an editor tool for the authoring pipeline; it does not ship by default.
note_cn: 可附加到网格、随移动修改景观的补丁组件，编辑器向。
note_en: Mesh-attachable patch components that modify landscape as they move, editor-oriented.

cn_steps: 启用 `Launcher Chunk Installer`（模块 `LauncherChunkInstaller`）。
它挂接到 Epic 启动器中的分块安装流程，用于通过启动器按块安装内容。
面向通过 Launcher 分发/更新构建的场景，配合分块打包使用。
这是启动器集成用的分块安装模块，不是游戏内 DLC UI。
en_steps: Enable `Launcher Chunk Installer` (module `LauncherChunkInstaller`).
It hooks into the Epic launcher's chunked-install flow to install content in chunks via the launcher.
Aimed at builds distributed/updated through the Launcher, used with chunked packaging.
It is a chunk-install module for launcher integration, not an in-game DLC UI.
note_cn: 挂到启动器的分块安装模块，用于 Launcher 分发。
note_en: A chunk-install module hooked into the launcher, for launcher distribution.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Learning Agents`（模块 `LearningAgents`、`LearningAgentsTraining`、`LearningAgentsReplay`，编辑器 `LearningAgentsTrainingEditor`）。
它用于游戏中 AI 角色控制的机器学习（强化学习/模仿学习）。
定义观察、动作、奖励，训练策略（可在编辑器里跑训练），再把学到的策略用于 NPC。
Experimental：接口可能变动；训练模块不进 Shipping，运行时用推理模块。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Learning Agents` (modules `LearningAgents`, `LearningAgentsTraining`, `LearningAgentsReplay`, editor `LearningAgentsTrainingEditor`).
It provides machine learning for AI character control (reinforcement/imitation learning).
Define observations, actions, and rewards, train a policy (editor training), and use the learned policy on NPCs.
Experimental: contract may change; training modules do not ship, use the runtime inference modules.
note_cn: 面向 AI 角色的机器学习库（RL/模仿学习），实验性。
note_en: A machine-learning library for AI character control (RL/imitation), experimental.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Learning Core`（模块 `Learning`、`LearningTraining`）。
它是 Learning 系列的最底层运行时底座，供上层 Learning Agents 等使用。
一般随 Learning Agents 一起启用；直接依赖只在写自定义学习逻辑时。
Experimental：接口可能变动；属底层库，不是可直接使用的玩法功能。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Learning Core` (modules `Learning`, `LearningTraining`).
It is the lowest-level runtime base for the Learning family, used by layers like Learning Agents.
Usually enabled with Learning Agents; depend on it directly only when writing custom learning logic.
Experimental: contract may change; it is a low-level library, not directly usable gameplay.
note_cn: Learning 系列底层运行时底座，上层是 Learning Agents。
note_en: The low-level runtime base for the Learning family; Learning Agents sits above it.
